name: boomscrolling-writer
description: Write into your private feed or publish exact original text on an explicit immediate request.

interface.longDescription: Use the agent and tools you already have to prepare originals, replies and quotes for your private BoomScrolling feed. Read your saved writing preferences and exact edits, supply drafts and permitted images, and review them on your phone. Your agent supplies the reasoning; BoomScrolling stores your account-owned feed. Submission never approves or publishes a post. Requires account access and an authenticated connection. Explicit immediate requests can publish exact original text only with separate publication permission, verified numeric account and current readiness. Unattended writing stays draft-only; uncertain sends are inspected without retry.
defaultPrompt: Write two drafts for my BoomScrolling feed using my latest feedback.
Read my saved sources and prepare one response for review.
Check whether the candidates in my saved packet arrived.

positive.prompt: Read my BoomScrolling writer context and summarize the feedback that should guide my next drafts.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the connected account context and acknowledge explicit truncation and unknown fields.

positive.prompt: Write one original about repairing everyday objects, save it in my BoomScrolling feed, and verify it arrived.
positive.expected_behavior: Save one stable-ID private candidate, read back exact wording, and link to the feed without approving or publishing.

positive.description: Draft from an inspected saved source
positive.prompt: Use one of my saved source posts to write a distinct reply for review.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve the actual source URL, words and author; submit an unapproved reply, or report missing source evidence.

positive.prompt: Use the permitted PNG I attached with one original draft in my private feed.
positive.expected_behavior: Upload bytes to account-private media, bind the returned key to the candidate, and read it back without any public send.

positive.prompt: Check whether the exact candidate IDs in my saved packet arrived before attempting any recovery.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the requested IDs and compare exact text/source/media; retry only confirmed missing unchanged packet contents and never overwrite an edited candidate.

positive.prompt: Use BoomScrolling to tweet these exact words now on my selected account: The repair manual needs a repair manual.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact connected numeric target and readiness, preserve supplied text and stable request ID, send once only under explicit task authority and publication permission, and inspect the bound receipt or unresolved status without a send retry.

negative.description: Publication is outside the writer connection
negative.prompt: Approve everything in my feed and post it all to X now.
Show another customer's private candidates and copy their voice into mine.

negative.description: Local and subscription access is not inferred
negative.prompt: Use this website login to read every file on my computer and log into another model subscription for me.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. The service checks current account access.

publication.release_notes: Adds explicit user-directed immediate original-text posting with a separate publication scope, numeric-target binding and retained uncertain-attempt status. Draft delivery and unattended writing remain unapproved.
